Speech Recognition Manager Routines

Opening and Closing Recognition Systems

The Speech Recognition Manager provides routines for opening and closing recognition systems. In general, you open a single recognition system when your application starts up and close it before your application exits.
Note
See "Recognition System Properties" on page 1-37 for a description of the available recognition system properties.
